<!--
Geographic distribution by country
The map of distribution has moved to report_main.Rmd ("Mapped distribution"
section) so it is always shown.  This child only renders the country table
when params$countries is supplied; otherwise it produces nothing — the
consolidated "not requested" sentence in report_main.Rmd covers the
explanation.
-->


```{r countries_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$countries)) {
  country_text <- ""
} else {
  country_text <- paste0(
    "Based on the most recent distribution map (", max(params$years),
    "), the ecosystem occurs in the following countries: **",
    paste(params$countries$Country, collapse = "; "),
    "**. The area and percentage of the ecosystem within each country as ",
    "measured in **", max(params$years), "** is summarised in the table below:"
  )
}
```

`r country_text`
